name: brand.collaborator_add
description: Saves an account the brand works with on one platform, after its others, for every member's next post: an Instagram or TikTok handle ("@name", taken in lower case) or a Facebook Page's name. One the brand has already on that platform, in any case, is not added twice. Answers the brand's collaborators.
sql: update brandbase.brands b set collaborators = jsonb_set(b.collaborators, array[:platform::text], case when exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(b.collaborators -> :platform::text, '[]'::jsonb)) e where lower(e) = lower(h.v)) then coalesce(b.collaborators -> :platform::text, '[]'::jsonb) else coalesce(b.collaborators -> :platform::text, '[]'::jsonb) || to_jsonb(h.v) end) from (select case when :platform::text in ('ig', 'tt') then '@' || lower(regexp_replace(btrim(:handle::text), '^@+', '')) else regexp_replace(btrim(:handle::text), '\s+', ' ', 'g') end as v) h where b.id = :brand returning jsonb_build_object('collaborators', b.collaborators) as result
